_comment: Ctx_i of the shared-tool forklift example (intent paper, Section 9, Table 7). K_AH: what Arrowhead knows; K_eng: engineering facts E1-E6; K_runtime/K_user: the current request (E7). The validator reads the machine-readable fields; the 'text' fields are given to the Translator.

reserve-tool.text: Reserve the shared tool for a line. Input: tool id and line (session parameters). Result: reservation token (lease).

release-tool.text: Release a reservation. Input: tool id and the reservation token, i.e. the result of reserve-tool.

get-program.text: Tightening program of a forklift variant. Input: variant (session parameter). Result: (bolt count, target torque N*m, relative tolerance).

transport-tool.text: AGV mission moving a tool. Input: tool id, from, to, and the reservation token, i.e. the result of reserve-tool. Long-running.

configure-tool.text: Load a tightening program into the nutrunner. Input: tool id and the program, i.e. the result of get-program.

tighten-fasteners.text: Tighten all fasteners according to the loaded program. Input: tool id and the confirmation of the loaded program, i.e. the result of configure-tool. Result: measured torques.

evaluate-tightening.text: Evaluate measured torques against a program. Input: the result of tighten-fasteners and the result of get-program. Result: OK or NOK.

record-tightening.text: Record a tightening result for traceability. Input: line, variant, tool id (session parameters) and the result of tighten-fasteners.

agvexecutor.text: Workflow Executor w_agv supervising long-running AGV missions.

authorization._comment: consumer -> services it may consume (E2). 'choreographer' is CH_i acting as consumer of non-delegated Steps.

K_AH._inputs_comment: requires_results: services whose Step results the input of a Step with this service is composed from (service interface / input composition kappa_s). Checked by V9.

facts.text: reserve-tool grants the tool to at most one requester; a request for a held tool stays pending until release-tool has been processed.
Only the Executor agvexecutor is authorized to consume transport-tool; Steps requiring it must set executor = agvexecutor.
The tool must be at the station (transport-tool to 'station' completed) before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners is invoked.

Tightening programs are defined per variant by the MES and obtained only through get-program. Target torque and tolerance must never appear as literals in a Recipe; Steps using the program depend on the get-program Step.
Quality policy: every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability.

Reservations are leases. A lease that is neither renewed nor released expires. Every tool-using Step renews the lease with the reservation token before the physical use and therefore depends on the reserve-tool Step.

Nominal durations (s): reserve-tool 1, release-tool 1, get-program 1, transport-tool 90, configure-tool 5, tighten-fasteners 60, evaluate-tightening 2, record-tightening 3. The tool lease is 120 s and is renewed before every physical use, so it must exceed the duration of every single tool-using Step.

preference._comment: Soft preference of the intent: hold the tool no longer than necessary. J(W) = estimated time from completion of reserve-tool to completion of release-tool (critical path over next_A and next_alpha with nominal durations). Ranks admissible Recipes; does not affect admission.
preference.name: tool_hold_s

K_runtime._comment: E7: current request and plant state.

kit._comment: Mapping to the runnable kit in ../forklift (Arrowhead 4.6.2): the plant's input composition kappa_s is keyed by these step ids; every service definition has its own Executor in the kit.
